description: qiick app-ui release pins: qiick-standards.json ref, the @qiick registry URL in components.json and the reusable workflows, bumped together in one PR. Extend with github>qiick-io/app-ui//renovate/app-ui.

packageRules.description: The reusable workflows (github-actions manager) move with the two pins above.
prBodyNotes: Before merging: run `node <app-ui at the new tag>/scripts/sync-standards.mjs --target .`, re-run `npx shadcn add @qiick/<item> --overwrite` for the items the CHANGELOG names, review `app-ui.overrides.json`, and follow the Upgrade notes: https://github.com/qiick-io/app-ui/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md
